# Strip

> Remove EXIF, GPS, camera and software metadata from JPG, PNG and WebP in the browser.

The public origin is https://strip-local.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

## Tools

* [Strip metadata](https://strip-local.vercel.app) — EXIF/GPS out in this tab.

## Guides

* [How to strip](https://strip-local.vercel.app/how-to) — Drop, strip, download.
* [iPhone](https://strip-local.vercel.app/iphone) — Photos may rewrite GPS. Files holds the strip.
* [WhatsApp](https://strip-local.vercel.app/whatsapp) — Chat recode vs document.
* [Marketplace](https://strip-local.vercel.app/marketplace) — Listings leak GPS.
* [What GPS leaks](https://strip-local.vercel.app/exif-gps) — The fields, not a lecture.
* [Why local](https://strip-local.vercel.app/why-local) — Why a server strip is the wrong bargain.
* [Use cases](https://strip-local.vercel.app/use-cases) — Before you post.
* [FAQ](https://strip-local.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy.

## Not on this origin

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API and no `/blogs/` cluster.
